purpose: Full report rewrite: timing, learning quality, and logged controller decisions

definitions.timing: Mean of seed means; omit round 0-3; 24-round runs use 3 seeds and 200-round runs use 2 seeds.
definitions.accuracy_32: Accuracy in final saved round 23, then mean of 3 seeds; short-run progress indicator.
definitions.accuracy_200: Mean accuracy over saved rounds 150-199 within each run, then mean of 2 seeds. Not 100 independent repeats.
definitions.evaluation: fed_server evaluates the largest width trained so far, on CIFAR-10 test indices 0-1999.
definitions.bytes: Sum per_client[k][2] over clients per round: application accounting of activation/label/gradient exchange; excludes TCP/IP headers, retransmissions and model aggregation; framing differs slightly by transport.
definitions.comparison: Full-width single-exit baseline versus widthpath with two exits. λ=280 preserves width=1.0 throughout the analyzed body.
definitions.scales: The 32-process timing and 8-process accuracy studies use different network and compute configurations.
definitions.mechanism: Path selection uses measured capacity estimates; splitting weights use configured capacity and shared allocation, not instantaneous per-chunk throughput.
